Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), positive nitrites, leukocyte esterase, elevated leukocytes, and presence of blood. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
